analysis.conditional_claim: Known uniform recorder plus fixed mask defines a conditional support hole. KNN checks relative training-state typicalness and marginal-a0 occupancy, not dense full-state or joint4D empirical support.
analysis.missing_label_causal_effect: not tested; no condition-specific models fitted

calibration_plan.calibration_scope: retained support only; no hole-conditional guarantee
calibration_plan.selection_rule: preserve original selected row if outside hole; otherwise uniform eligible row in same episode using separate fixed PCG64 seed; identical rows across all arms

data_identity.freshness: Already development-consumed logged episodes; not untouched confirmation

support.reference_selection: SHA256('central-quartile-reference-v1:'+source_row_id), distinct episode first; independent of actions and outcomes
support.scope: Training-relative state typicalness and marginal a0 occupancy, not absolute state density or joint 4D action support
